{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Silk slip dress, fluid bias cut, midi length, soft champagne color (#F5E6CA), pure silk.
Block heels with a wide strap, moderate height, nude leather tone (#C0A080), smooth calfskin.
A lightweight linen-blend blazer, structured boxy cut, cropped to hip length, pale cream color (#FAF9F6), breathable woven fabric.
This outfit respects your wish against a forced style shift by blending the elegance of a summer evening with comfortable, recovery-friendly fabrics that feel gentle on the skin. The champagne slip dress offers a sophisticated yet effortless look suitable for a restaurant setting, while the blazer provides an optional layer if needed without feeling heavy or restrictive. Pairing nude heels maintains a continuous line from leg to waist, honoring your preference against matching tights and ensuring you feel confident and supported as you celebrate with your partner in his smoking jacket."}
